_comment: v5 — whole numbers only, no appearance points, penalties worth the same as an open-play goal inside the box. Only clean sheets and goals conceded vary by position. Goalkeeping actions are position-specific by nature. EXCLUDED, feed incomplete in 2025/26: offsides, dispossessed, saves inside box. EXCLUDED, not collected by any free source: big chances created, errors leading to a chance or goal, penalties won, successful corners, passes into the box, passes received in the box.
